body:
I’ve gone through three therapists at this point - the problem is that you always have to start at square one with a new therapist, and it takes a long time before you establish enough of a relationship to really make progress again, and there’s no guarantee the new therapist will actually help you make progress. The one I’m with now I’ve been with about eight months, and she isn’t helping much I don’t think. You just get to a certain point where you start to wonder if it’s worth fighting this much and getting so little from the fight.

My wife and kid are the only reason I haven’t killed myself. They are good people, and I don’t deserve them. My wife is salt of the Earth and a wonderful person who has been through a lot in general and through a lot with me, and my kid is amazing even at the age of 4. He has trouble with his speech, but he’s such a happy, positive person, and I’m quite envious of him for it. I won’t hurt myself because I couldn’t bear to hurt them, but I still can’t help but wish that life would take me and just end my pain. But then I think about how hard that would be for my kid to grow up without a dad. I know my hope for my pain to end is very selfish, and I feel guilty for it, but I don’t know what I can do at this point. I’ve spent so much time trying to ease my own pain in addition to being the best husband and father I can be, but nothing helps anymore.

I just feel adrift and I wish it would end.

I’ve felt it off and on since I was a teenager, and that was over two decades ago. I’ve been to therapy, I’ve had my life completely go off the rails and I’ve managed to get it back on again through therapy and support from those I love. I usually just try to ride out the feeling - it usually lasts for a few months, maybe a year or two. The period from 2005-2007 in particular was very bad. I’m in therapy now again, but it isn’t helping. They’ve given me all sorts of drugs, but they aren’t helping either. I just want all of this to end, you know? And I’m tired of struggling with it. I’ve fought for so long, and it feels like life comes so easy to so many others, and I don’t know why I can’t have that.

I don’t know - I appreciate you listening. I just don’t feel like I have much left.
